verdict.rationale: BugSnag's docs describe automatic grouping: events that share the same error class, file and line number of the top in-project stack frame are rolled into one issue, so duplicates are consolidated by impact. The pack has no evidence that developers can customize or override grouping when it is wrong. The automation-rules item covers error assignment, not grouping. missing for 10: documented custom grouping/fingerprint override or manual merge/unmerge of issues, independent or hands-on corroboration of grouping accuracy at scale.
